correctness.rationale: The graph is the 12 ordered pairs (i,j), i != j, with triangle and reversal edges; the degree-two bounded-degree complex includes the empty face. Independent exhaustive reconstruction gave 69,075 faces including empty and the exact 12-term f-vector, 34,533 augmented toggle pairs (34,532 nonempty pairs after basepoint transfer), one ordinary critical vertex plus seven 8-cells and two 9-cells. The full nonempty Hasse DAG with 485,070 arrows is acyclic; the independent signed Morse matrix has rows (0,0),(0,1),(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1), a primitive rank-two image with unit 2x2 minor. Since the 8-skeleton is a wedge of seven S8 and pi8 equals H8, this cancels two attachments, yielding five S8 without torsion. Enumerating all 24 S4 vertex permutations and every invariant face recovers class traces identity 5, transposition -1, double transposition 1, three-cycle 2, four-cycle 1 and 1+sgn+(sgn tensor Std4). No integral S4 lattice or equivariant wedge asserted.
